source.raw_text: . Mr. NYE. Seven dollars and eighty cents to send ten words from San Francisco to New York or Washington ; and from Carson City, wliere I reside, the price is the same, although that is three hundred miles nearer.. Now, sir, if t!ie Senator from Ohio, with his acute legal mind, will set himself to work to control the jnices upon these old lines, he will do his country a substantial service ; but I repeat, in my judgment, he never can effect it by this bill for a line v/hich only exists in fancy, the pur- chase of which will increase the capital of the present monopoly, and every time the capital IS increased the pi-ice for telegraphing is in- creased.
